[[Blood Ruby|Blood Rubies]] are the map currency for [[Bloodstone Fen]].

== Acquisition ==
=== Gathered from ===
{{gathered from}}
* Known gathering amounts from the above are as follows:
** 3 from the home instance [[Bloodstone Crystal Node]] <small>(once per account, per day)</small>
** [[Defeat the spirit of Justiciar Hablion]] - 3 from the [[Bloodstone Chest]] <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
** [[Bloodstone Maw (meta event)|Bloodstone Maw]] meta event:
*** [[Defeat the jade constructs before they drain the bloodstone!]] - 2 from the [[Large Bloodstone Chest]] <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
*** [[Disperse the Unbound Guardian]] - 4 from the [[Large Bloodstone Chest]]
** [[The spirits mostly come out at night. Mostly...]] meta event:
*** [[Escort Alari Doubleblade on her quest for vengeance]] -  1 from the [[Bloodstone Chest]] <small>(once per character, per day)</small>
** 1 from the arena event at the end of the [[Confessor's Stronghold]] story step
